reports.text: First day back at school, classes look fine. Went to the gym after, legs day, felt strong.
Worked on the startup landing page all evening, shipped the signup form.
Gym again, bench went up. Dinner with the family was nice, dad told old stories.
Went out with Arash and the guys to play football, good laugh.
items: Football with the guys — morale high

reports.text: Date night with Sara, we watched a film and walked home. Really happy.
Lazy Sunday, read a book for two hours and tidied my room.
Gym in the morning before class. Third session in a row.
Aced the physics quiz, 19 out of 20. Professor mentioned it in class.
items: Physics quiz aced — armour breaks through

reports.text: Work: fixed the login bug that had been bothering users for a week.
Gym, new squat record. Feeling consistent.
Arash's birthday party, saw everyone, stayed late.
Spent too much money this week on food delivery, a bit annoyed with myself.
Had a big fight with my mom about how much time I spend on the startup. She yelled, I yelled back and slammed the door.
items: Row at home — enemy aircraft strafe the line

reports.text: Couldn't focus in class after last night. Gym helped a little.
Apologised to my mom, we talked it out over tea. She is still worried but we are fine.
Shipped the onboarding flow for the startup. Twelve new signups.
Sara and I cooked dinner together. Gym in the morning.
Gym. Routine is solid now, four weeks without missing.
Chemistry homework handed in on time. Lecture was boring but fine.
A friend of my uncle introduced me to an investor called Kaveh. Investor meeting is set for next Friday. Excited and nervous.
items: Introduction to an investor — supplies arrive

reports.text: Gym, then worked on the pitch deck until 3am. Barely slept.
items: Up till three — supply hub hit

reports.text: Stayed up late again on the deck, slept four hours. Skipped studying for the chemistry midterm.
items: Four hours of sleep — depots burning

reports.text: Exhausted. Did nothing all day except scroll on my phone.
Forgot the chemistry homework, teacher was not happy. Skipped the gym, too tired.
items: Homework forgotten — sabotage behind the line

reports.text: Tried to cram for the midterm, nothing went in. Skipped gym again.
Failed the chemistry midterm. 8 out of 20. I knew it while writing it. Feel awful.
items: Chemistry midterm failed — enemy armour breaks the line

reports.text: The investor meeting with Kaveh went well. He liked the demo and wants a follow-up with real numbers in a month.
Slept until noon. Sara came over, quiet evening.
Mom found out about the failed midterm and we had another fight. She said the startup is ruining school. I said things I regret.
items: Second row over the midterm — air attack

reports.text: Haven't been to the gym in ten days. Can't be bothered.
Asked the chemistry professor for a retake, she said yes, end of the month.
Made peace with mom. Promised a study schedule and she promised to stop checking my grades every day.
Work: two users churned, one complained about speed. Annoying.
Studied chemistry for three hours in the library. Felt good to be back on it.
items: Three hours in the library — advance

reports.text: Sara was upset that I cancelled on her twice for work. We argued on the phone for an hour.
items: An hour of arguing — air raid

reports.text: Studied again, did two past papers. Still no gym.
Took Sara out for dinner to make up for it. We're good.
Fixed the speed problem in the app, page loads twice as fast.
Skipped the gym for the third week. Ate junk. Feel heavy.
Budget review: saved a bit this month despite everything.
Argued with dad about the car, he thinks I'm careless. Short but nasty.
items: Sharp exchange over the car — strafing run

reports.text: Went back to the gym for the first time in three weeks. Weak but glad I went.
Retook the chemistry midterm and passed, 15 out of 20. Huge relief.
items: Midterm retaken and passed — counterattack retakes the heights

reports.text: Celebrated by working on the startup all night, built the metrics dashboard. Slept three hours.
items: Three hours of sleep — depot hit

reports.text: Up until 4am again on the dashboard. Barely slept, head is foggy.
Tired all day, did not start the history essay.
History essay handed in late, lost marks. Fell asleep in the lecture.
Gym session, short but done.
Got the maths test back, 9 out of 20. Did not study enough.
items: Maths test nine of twenty — retreat

reports.text: Fight with mom again, this time about the maths grade and me being on the laptop at midnight. She cried, I felt terrible.
items: Third row at home — heavy air attack

reports.text: Quiet day. Talked to mom a little at breakfast, still tense.
Gym, full session. Slept eight hours for the first time in weeks.
items: Eight hours of sleep — reserves up

reports.text: One year anniversary with Sara. We went to Darband, had lunch by the river, she gave me a letter. Best day in a long time.
items: Best day in a long time — morale up

reports.text: School was okay, caught up on history notes.
Gym, three sessions in a row now.
items: Three in a row — roads rebuilt

reports.text: Sent Kaveh the numbers he asked for. He replied within an hour and wants a second call.
items: Numbers sent, second call requested — advance

reports.text: Gym in the morning, then got an A on the history presentation.
Tired, skipped studying, watched series.
First paying customer for the startup! Also hit a bench PR at the gym. What a day.
Had lunch with mom and dad, calm and nice. Planned the week.
Chemistry lecture was fine, understood everything.
